newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's IRI meets on Seat selloff.
newsitem.headline: Italy's IRI meets on Seat selloff.

text.p: Italian state industrial holding company IRI is discussing the sale of the yellow pages publishing division of state telecoms group Stet, an IRI director said.
Antonio Urcioli told reporters that the IRI board and shareholders had begun a meeting to examine how to spin off of the Seat unit.
"The government's idea to spin off Seat is being considered," he said as he entered the meeting, adding that any decision would be in line with the government's directions.

The government last month ordered IRI to evaluate the spinoff of Seat before the sale of Stet in February or March 1997. It also said IRI should consider the possibility of selling off Stet units cable-layer Sirti and switchgear maker Italtel. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
